name: Because of This — Cinematic Editorial Cartoon
purpose: Reusable visual identity for original suspenseful science Shorts.
medium: premium cinematic editorial cartoon with realistic proportions
visual_character: clear silhouettes and readable physical relationships

palette.rule: Use one dominant base, one emotional accent, and one controlled highlight.

lighting.default: cinematic directional lighting with deep shadows and a readable subject
lighting.suspense: single motivated practical light, subtle rim light, restrained haze

composition.subject_rule: one primary subject or relationship per frame
composition.depth: foreground, readable middle subject, atmospheric background
composition.negative_space: reserve clean space for later captions without covering the focal subject
composition.camera: clear editorial framing; use close-up, medium, wide, overhead or tracking perspective only when the beat requires it

texture: clean edges around the focal subject
story_rules: each image must visualize one narrative beat
the image must make sense without the caption
show cause, consequence, danger, isolation or discovery when relevant
prefer physical relationships over decorative symbolism
maintain recurring subjects across scenes through a visual bible
hard_constraints: no invented readable documents or labels
no generic space or laboratory filler when the script specifies a concrete scene
negative_prompt: childish cartoon, cute mascot, chibi proportions, photorealistic stock photo, flat vector clipart, glossy plastic 3D render, generic filler background, collage, split screen, duplicate subject, extra limbs, deformed hands, unreadable text, fake labels, logo, watermark, UI, infographic, neon overload, random lens flare, oversaturated colors, low contrast subject, cluttered composition

render_policy.reference_policy: References guide facts, composition and continuity; final artwork must be newly generated and must not copy a reference frame.
